output.murderer: Dr Casimir Vauthier, the family physician
output.reasoning: Lina: hall struck ten when the regulator (correct at the temple bell) showed 9:48, so the hall is 12 min fast and struck eleven at true 10:48. The master reset Rosa's kitchen clock in the afternoon (Lina saw him laughing with it). Kitchen read 11:13 at the hall's eleven, so it is 25 min fast. Piano ran true 10:33-10:46; Lina reached the kitchen at 10:22. Girard came in when the hall face showed 11:02 (true 10:50) and his watch read 10:46, so his watch is 4 min slow. That puts the piano start at 10:33 (consistent) and the repeater bells at 10:38. Félix's watch (about 20 min slow) gives the climb at about 10:35, the thump and ten-o'clock chime at about 10:38, and the descent at about 10:41. Madame played the whole time the doctor was out, so he was absent 10:33-10:46, covering the climb, the blow and the descent. His 'quarter to eleven' on a watch 2 min fast (true 10:43) contradicts the 10:33 departure; he admits he fiddles with his watch, and he also contradicts Madame about the cigars. The regulator was running at 10:20, so its 10:05 was staged to fake a piquet-time alibi. Everyone else is placed elsewhere at 10:38. The exact minute rests mainly on Girard's watch; Félix's wandering watch agrees within a minute or two.
